items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: See, the only thing I knew was Sadie Stratikas. She was a very gorgeous looking woman.

ctx.x: I want to know more about Ellis. Ellis Stratikas? We just touched on that. All right.

Ellis Stratikas, his father had a candy cigar and a candy store on one of the main streets in Gulfport, Mississippi. He was actually from Gulfport, Mississippi. That was his home. That was his, where he lived. Of course, he did, he married a woman and I remember her name. Her name was Sadie. See, the only thing I knew was Sadie Stratikas. She was a very gorgeous looking woman. Ellis was a very handsome guy. And they had a wonderful life together. And I don't know if Sadie's still alive, but... She passed away a…
I know the name, I never met him. I never met him.
